source_text: - Every claim and edge needs span.quote copied from the passage (short exact phrase). - One step ≈ one conclusion move. Split when two moves each could stand alone. - Edge types only from the schema enum (supports, depends_on, causes, correlates, appeals_to_source, attacks_person, attacks_claim, misattributes, shifts_burden, selects_subset, ignores, instantiates). - For repeated key words that look sense-shifting: fill terms + bindings with distinct sense_ids and glosses. - For person attacks: create agents with traits, and attacks_person edges. - For selective evidence: create evidence_sets and selects_subset / ignores edges. - A particular case offered as settling a group → instantiates from the case to the general conclusion. - A chain of steps to an extreme result → one causes edge per step. - “Either / or” or “the only choice” used to settle a conclusion → that exclusive premise and a supports edge into the conclusion. - Many or most people offered as the reason a claim is true or right → appeals_to_source. - Set extractor.charity_applied: true when these rules were applied.
